sections.title: 1. General provisions
sections.content:
This Privacy Policy (the "Policy") describes how Lumiva CRM (the "Company", "we", "us") collects, uses, stores, and protects the personal data of users of the lumiva.agency platform (the "Platform", "Service").

By using the Platform, you agree to the terms of this Policy. If you do not agree, please stop using the Service.

The Policy applies to all users: individuals, organization representatives, and any other people interacting with the Platform. It covers all products, websites, and mobile apps operating under the Lumiva CRM brand.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
sections.content:
**2.1 Data you provide directly:**
- First name, last name, or a display name
- Email address
- Phone number (when filling out forms)
- Organization name and job title
- Payment details (processed by the payment provider, not stored on our servers)
- Any data entered into the CRM (contacts, deals, notes, files)

**2.2 Data collected automatically:**
- IP address and country/city-level geolocation
- Browser type, operating system, screen resolution
- Login date and time, session duration
- Pages and features you visit and use
- UTM tags and referral sources
- Error and crash data (logs)

**2.3 Data from third-party sources:**
- Information from connected integrations (Google Analytics, Meta Ads, AmoCRM, and others) — only to the extent you explicitly authorized when connecting
- Publicly available profile data (if you sign in via OAuth)

sections.title: 3. Purposes of processing
sections.content:
We process your data solely for the following purposes:

**3.1 Providing the Service:**
Creating and managing your account, granting access to CRM features, syncing data across devices, fulfilling contractual obligations.

**3.2 Improving the product:**
Analyzing feature usage, identifying bugs and bottlenecks, prioritizing new development. Data is anonymized or aggregated before analysis.

**3.3 Communication:**
Sending transactional emails (registration confirmation, password reset, plan change notices) and responding to support requests. Marketing emails only with your explicit consent.

**3.4 Security:**
Preventing fraud, unauthorized access, and abuse. Complying with legal requirements.

**3.5 Billing:**
Issuing invoices, processing payments, keeping financial records. Transaction data is retained in accordance with tax law requirements.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
sections.content:
We process data on the following legal bases:

**Contract performance** — when processing is necessary to provide the Service you requested (account creation, transactions).

**Legitimate interest** — for improving security, preventing abuse, and enhancing the product. In these cases we balance our interests against your privacy rights.

**Consent** — for marketing emails and analytics cookies. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting your use of the Service.

**Legal obligation** — when processing is required to comply with applicable law (tax, accounting, or regulator requests).

sections.title: 5. Storage and protection of data
sections.content:
**5.1 Where data is stored:**
Data is stored on servers in secure data centers. Core infrastructure is located in Russia and/or the EU. Backups are created daily and stored encrypted.

**5.2 Retention periods:**
- Account and CRM data: for the full term of the contract + 30 days after account deletion
- Financial documents: 5 years (legal requirement)
- Technical logs: 90 days
- Support request data: 2 years

**5.3 Protection measures:**
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.3
- Encryption at rest: AES-256
- Multi-factor authentication for staff
- Regular security audits and penetration testing
- Multi-tenant architecture: each account is isolated at the database level
- Restricted staff access to data — only on a documented need basis and on request

**5.4 Incident notification:**
In the event of a data breach that could pose a risk to your rights, we will notify you and the relevant regulators within the timeframes required by law (no later than 72 hours).

sections.title: 6. Sharing data with third parties
sections.content:
We **do not sell** your personal data to third parties.

**6.1 Contractors and sub-processors:**
We may share data with trusted service providers who help us operate: cloud infrastructure, payment systems, support services. Every sub-processor is bound by a contract requiring data protection standards no less strict than ours.

**6.2 Integrations you choose:**
If you connect third-party services (Google, Meta, Telegram, etc.), data is shared with those services per their own privacy policies. You can disconnect an integration at any time.

**6.3 Corporate transactions:**
In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your data may be transferred to the new owner — with notice to you and your rights preserved.

**6.4 Legal requirements:**
We may disclose data in response to a valid request from government authorities, courts, or regulators. In such cases, we aim to notify you unless prohibited by law.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.content:
You have the following rights regarding your personal data:

**Right of access** — request confirmation of whether we process your data, and obtain a copy of it.

**Right to rectification** — request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data. Most data can be updated yourself in account settings.

**Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")** — request deletion of your personal data. We will delete data no longer needed for the processing purposes, except where retention is legally required.

**Right to restrict processing** — request that processing be paused in certain situations (for example, while you dispute its accuracy).

**Right to data portability** — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (CSV/JSON) to transfer to another provider.

**Right to object** — object to processing based on legitimate interest, including for direct marketing.

**Right to withdraw consent** — withdraw previously given consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.

To exercise any of these rights, contact **privacy@lumiva.agency**. We will respond within 30 days. If we decline a request, we will explain why.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.content:
**8.1 What cookies are:**
Cookies are small text files stored by your browser. We use them to run the Service, for analytics, and for personalization.

**8.2 Types of cookies:**

*Essential (technical)* — required for the Platform to work: authentication, security, load balancing. Cannot be disabled.

*Analytics* — help us understand how the Service is used (Google Analytics 4, Yandex Metrica). Data is anonymized. Can be disabled in settings.

*Marketing* — used to show relevant ads (Meta Pixel, Google Ads). Set only with your consent.

**8.3 Managing cookies:**
You can manage cookies via your browser settings or the consent banner on first visit. Disabling analytics cookies does not affect CRM functionality.

sections.title: 9. Cross-border data transfers
sections.content:
If you are located in the EU/EEA, the UK, or another jurisdiction with cross-border transfer restrictions, we apply appropriate safeguards:

- Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission
- Transfers to countries with an adequacy decision
- Specific legal mechanisms for particular jurisdictions

A list of countries and mechanisms used is available on request at privacy@lumiva.agency.

sections.title: 10. Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
sections.content:
If your organization uses Lumiva CRM to process your customers' personal data, you are the controller and we are the data processor.

We're ready to sign a Data Processing Agreement, which includes:
- A description of data subject categories and data types
- Processing purposes and instructions
- Technical and organizational security measures
- Terms for engaging sub-processors
- Incident response procedures

To request a DPA template or negotiate individual terms, contact privacy@lumiva.agency.

sections.title: 11. Children and minors
sections.content:
Lumiva CRM is intended for use by people 18 years of age or older (or the age of digital consent in your jurisdiction).

We do not knowingly collect children's data. If we learn that a child's data was collected without parental consent, we will delete it immediately.

If you believe a child has provided us with data, please contact us at privacy@lumiva.agency.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this Policy
sections.content:
We may update this Policy from time to time. For material changes, we will notify you by email or via a banner on the Platform at least 14 days before the change takes effect.

The date of the last update is shown at the bottom of the page. Continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Policy.

Previous versions of the Policy are available on request.

sections.title: 13. Use of Google API Services data
sections.content:
If you connect your Google account to Lumiva CRM, we request access only to the services you explicitly select when connecting:

**Gmail** — reading and sending email on behalf of the connected mailbox, so that conversations appear inside the CRM and you can send messages to customers directly from the system. We do not use email content to serve ads, do not share it with third parties, and do not use it to train general-purpose AI models.

**Google Calendar** — reading and creating events in your connected calendar to keep meetings in sync with the CRM.

**Google Sheets** — exporting and importing CRM data to and from the spreadsheets you connect.

**Google Ads** — read-only access to spend and campaign statistics of the ad account you connect, shown in the "Marketing" section.

**Google Analytics** — read-only access to website traffic data from the GA4 property you connect.

**Google Search Console** — read-only access to organic search data for the site you connect.

**Retention and deletion:** data obtained through these services is retained only for as long as the connection is active and is deleted within 30 days of disconnecting it. Access tokens are stored encrypted and used solely to make API requests on your behalf.

**Revoking access:** you can disconnect any of these integrations at any time in the "Integrations" section of Lumiva CRM, or directly in your Google Account settings at myaccount.google.com/permissions.

**Limited Use:** Lumiva CRM's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

sections.title: 14. Contact us
sections.content:
For privacy questions, exercising your rights, or inquiries related to data processing:

**Email:** privacy@lumiva.agency
**General questions:** hello@lumiva.agency
**Contact form:** lumiva.agency/contact

A Data Protection Officer (DPO) has been appointed and is reachable at the contacts above.

If you believe your rights have been violated, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority in your country (in Russia — Roskomnadzor, in the EU — your member state's supervisory authority).

security.title: Security & Data Protection
security.subtitle: How data protection actually works in Lumiva CRM — infrastructure, application, and access. No marketing promises, only what's actually implemented.

s1Items.title: Encryption in transit
s1Items.desc: All connections to the platform use TLS 1.3.

s1Items.title: Encryption at rest
s1Items.desc: Data in the database is encrypted with AES-256.

s1Items.title: Password storage
s1Items.desc: User passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes — the password itself is never stored in plain text or recoverable, only resettable.

s2Items.title: Multi-tenant architecture
s2Items.desc: Each customer's (tenant's) data is isolated at the database level — one tenant cannot reach another's data through the API.

s2Items.title: Role-based access control (RBAC)
s2Items.desc: Access to sections and actions is determined by staff role within the tenant; newer modules have granular permissions (e.g. separate rights for pricing, settings, catalog management).

s3Items.title: Rate limiting
s3Items.desc: The API is protected against overload and brute-force attempts: 20 requests per second and 100 requests per 10 seconds.

s3Items.title: Security HTTP headers
s3Items.desc: Applied via Helmet — protection against clickjacking, MIME-sniffing, and other common header-level attacks.

s3Items.title: Mandatory token secret
s3Items.desc: JWT_SECRET is required in the environment with no fallback default — this eliminates a whole class of vulnerabilities from a guessable secret.

s3Items.title: Configurable CORS
s3Items.desc: The list of allowed origins is set explicitly via an environment variable, not left open to any source.

security.s4Text: The Products module keeps a full change log — price, cost, status, SKU, barcode — with the author and time of every change. Equivalent logging for other CRM modules (Leads, Deals, Projects) isn't implemented to the same extent yet — it's on the backlog, not a shipped feature.

s5Items.desc: You can request an export or deletion of your data — timelines and process are described in the Privacy Policy.

s5Items.title: Choice of storage region
s5Items.desc: Data is stored in secure data centers in Russia and/or the EU.
